title: Soldatenarbeitszeitverordnung (SAZV), § 5 Regelmäßige wöchentliche Arbeitszeit, in der vor dem 1. April 2025 geltenden Fassung (a.F.), as transcribed by buzer.de
in_force: no: the version in force until 31 March 2025, before Art. 5 No. 1 of BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 (in force 1 April 2025, Art. 7(1)); it stands again only if that instruction is void
verified_how: Fetched https://www.buzer.de/gesetz/11778/al211499-0.htm (buzer's comparison page 'Änderung § 5 SAZV vom 01.04.2025', a.F. beside n.F.) on 2026-11-02 with curl and the User-Agent 'legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)', after reading https://www.buzer.de/robots.txt (it allows these paths). HTML page sha256 ee9271e3c9c718b06d87454677a61190db443b3767c09eddb7a1b85cff5c73df. Converted by a script: the unchanged blocks and the 'Text alte Fassung' column only, in page order, one line per paragraph or list item; buzer's sentence numbers, its labels and its highlighting were dropped and its heading replaced by line 1. The Federal Law Gazette text of the 2015 Regulation (BGBl. I S. 1995) was NOT read. Checked against what the gazette does determine: Art. 5 No. 1(a) of BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 strikes 'mit einer Verkürzung der Arbeitszeit um weniger als 10 Prozent' from § 5(2) sentence 1 (bgbl-2025-i-78.txt:134), and this file's sentence 1 is the current sentence 1 (sazv-5.txt:10) with exactly those words after 'Teilzeitbeschäftigung'; paragraphs (1), (3), (4) and (5) are word for word the current text (sazv-5.txt). § 5(2) sentence 2 of this file ('Aus dienstlichen Gründen kann die regelmäßige wöchentliche Arbeitszeit auf Montag bis Samstag verteilt werden.') rests on buzer alone: Art. 5 No. 1(b) replaces the old sentence 2 without quoting it. buzer lists two earlier versions of § 5 (the 2015 original, and one from 1 January 2021 by Art. 1 of BGBl. 2022 I Nr. 34, which changed only § 5(1) sentence 1 no. 2(b), bgbl-2022-i-34-flow.txt:24).
notes: An aid, not the law: buzer.de is a private consolidation. German is the only authoritative language; any English in the encoding is a gloss. Deposited for the encoding legalese-opus-5.5 (the reading on which BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 78 Art. 5 No. 1 is void).
